item.title: SJ Earthquakes launch program to teach soccer fundamentals to Bay Area kids
item.description: From a bird's eye view of the recreation field at Gardner Elementary School, a young student heaves a soccer ball as part of a throw-in. Then, several children form a scrum as they run to corral and control the ball.The action was part of the learning taking place in the Willow Glen area of San Jose.The San Jose Earthquakes on Friday launched its "Beautiful Game Assembly Program," intending to impart to youths from across the South Bay fundamental soccer skills ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup."

item.title: Livermore female chefs and winemakers celebrate women's history
item.description: More than a dozen female Livermore Valley chefs and winemakers are coming together for a special night to celebrate womanhood.
